name: @stewardmd/capacitor-mlx
description: iOS-only MLX engine for MaiK's on-device answers, beside capacitor-llama. Same JS contract as the Llama plugin (load/generate/cancel/release, llamaToken events). The prompt and the answer never leave the device.
author: StewardMD
_vendored: StewardMD-authored local plugin. NOT in the root package.json until the owner approves raising the app to iOS 17 (MLX's floor). See Package.swift and docs/MAIK_MLX_SPIKE.md. No Android side: Android keeps capacitor-llama.
